description: The donut chart visually represents the distribution of topics within the $M^3EL$ dataset, which is designed for multi-modal entity linking across multiple tasks and topics. The chart is divided into five distinct segments, each corresponding to a specific topic category as indicated in the central legend: “Movie” (light blue, 41.2%), “Person” (pink, 30.5%), “Book” (yellow, 9.1%), “Sport” (purple, 4.3%), and an unlabeled gray segment (14.9%), which may represent a miscellaneous or unclassified category. The segments are arranged in descending order of proportion clockwise from the top, with percentage values explicitly labeled on each slice. The chart employs a clean, minimalist design with a white center hole and subtle gray borders around each segment, enhancing readability and emphasizing the relative proportions of each topic within the dataset.
